description: Spaarndammerbuurt-Midden (BAG 1935), Polanenstraat 229-311: a 6.2 m brown-purple brick front of a narrow window axis at the party wall and a wide three-light window, white frames, on three storeys, the third storey's window low in a tall brick storey, a white-rendered attic band of three small lights under the row's deep flat-roof overhang; on the ground a round-arched portiek door at the party wall (two neighbours' doors stand under one arch) and a wide window; mirrored in pairs so the arches fall on every second party wall

overhang.note: a deep fascia band (rectified 15.0-16.0 m, grey-brown in the street's light, #706a5a raw beside brick #4e4744) along the whole row over the white attic

door-left.note: the portiek arch stands on the party wall (rectified 1.8-2.0 m wide, crown 2.7 m); each house draws its half as a 0.9 m arched door

match.note: the 1935 Polanenstraat rows; the 1924 fronts at 181-221 are another design

rhythm.bays: a narrow window axis at the party wall and a wide axis
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: arched door + 1 wide | 1-3: 1 narrow + 1 wide | attic: 3 small
rhythm.symmetry: mirrored in pairs: the arched doors and the narrow axes meet on every second party wall, the wide windows on the others
rhythm.groundFloor: round-arched portiek door at the party wall, one wide window
rhythm.roofline: flat roof with a deep fascia band over a white attic

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2022-12-14 (40 px/m, camera 2.1 m), ruler crops 44.4-57.8 and 63-107 m: arches centred on the party walls at 44.9, 57.35, 69.47, 81.9 and 94.6 m (1.8-2.0 m wide, crown 2.7 m); Polanenstraat 245 (69.47-75.55): narrow window 0.73-1.73 m, wide window 3.4-5.7 m; sills/heads 0.8/2.65, 3.85/5.8, 7.0/8.95, 10.15/12.1 m; white band 13.95-15.0 m with three 1.2 m lights at 14.05-14.95 m; fascia 15.0-16.0 m

schemaLimits: the portiek arch is one opening across the party wall; each house draws its half as a narrow arched door, so the pair reads as two arches side by side
the ground window stands 1.2 m nearer the door than on the photo (the ground storey's own bay widths centre it)
the overhang is drawn flat-ended; the attic's thin white sill ledge under the band
